services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services Across Leicester
services_subhead: From single-room refreshes to full house transformations, we handle interior and exterior work with care and precision.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Refresh your living spaces with expert interior painting. We prepare walls properly, apply premium paints, and leave your home spotless.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Protect and refresh your property's exterior. We use weather-resistant finishes and handle doors, fascias, soffits, and brick painting.

services.title: Wallpaper Hanging & Removal
services.desc: Professional wallpaper installation or careful removal without damage. We match patterns precisely and work to the highest standards.

services.title: Feature Walls & Accent Colours
services.desc: Add character with bold feature walls or trending accent colours. We help you choose the right shade and execute it flawlessly.

services.title: Woodwork & Trim Painting
services.desc: Skirting boards, doors, window frames, and kitchen cabinets. We sand, prime, and finish with smooth, durable paint.

services.title: Commercial Painting
services.desc: Shop fronts, office spaces, and industrial units. We work around your schedule and maintain a tidy site throughout.

about_pullquote: A fresh coat changes everything. We make sure it's done right.
about_para_1: Silky Painter has been transforming homes and businesses across Leicester for over 12 years. What started as a passion for quality finishes has grown into a trusted local decorator, handling everything from single-room redecorations to full house renovations. We take pride in every project, no matter the size.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on attention to detail, tidy work sites, and honest pricing. We listen to what you want, prepare your space properly, and deliver finishes that last. Hundreds of Leicester homeowners return to us or recommend us to neighbours — that's what matters most.
reviews_heading: What Leicester Homeowners Say About Silky Painter

reviews.text: Couldn't fault the job. Mark came and painted our hallway and landing, moved all the furniture, protected everything. Finished on time, tidy, and the finish is brilliant. Fair price too. Will definitely use again.
reviews.author: David R.

reviews.text: Had our lounge and kitchen done. The team were polite, professional, and got the job done without fuss. Colours look exactly as we'd hoped. Highly recommend Silky Painter.
reviews.author: Jennifer T.

reviews.text: Exterior painted our whole house last summer. Brilliant job, very thorough prep work, and they cleaned up after themselves properly. Would use again in a heartbeat.
